note: The kit's design tokens: the colours and sizes every built-in component takes by default, which a document changes by defining tokens of the same names. A colour has a dark value (the base) and a light one; the light ones apply once a document names a token of the kit itself, chosen by its theme.

kit.surface.about: Menus, dialogs, toasts, cards and popovers.

kit.bar.about: Menu bars, toolbars and status bars.

kit.barHover.about: A bar's item under the pointer, focused or open.

kit.dim.about: Secondary text: shortcuts, hints, disabled items.

kit.body.about: A dialog's message and a card's text.

kit.selection.about: The highlighted item of a menu or a list.

kit.secondary.about: Other buttons, tracks, a pressed or checked item.

kit.accent.about: Matched letters, links and the focused item's mark.

kit.focus.about: The ring of the focused button.

kit.radius.about: The corners of menus, buttons and fields.

kit.cardRadius.about: The corners of dialogs, toasts, cards and popovers.
